nl_text: The rschema_0125 database is designed to manage a collection of web pages and their associated comments and version records. The 'page' table stores information about each page, including its unique identifier, edit status, visibility status, and the active version number. The 'comment' table contains comments left by users, with each comment linked to the page it belongs to and optionally referencing a parent comment. The 'version_record' table tracks changes made to each page, storing the page number, version number, image URL, and description of the changes made. The 'page' table serves as the primary key for both the 'comment' and 'version_record' tables, with the 'comment' table referencing the 'page' table through its 'belonging_page' column and the 'version_record' table referencing the 'page' table through its 'page_number' column, enforcing referential integrity by cascading any changes made to a page to its associated comments and version records.
gold_question: The multilingual wiki system shall record and manage page content in different languages. Each page shall have configurable settings for editability and visibility. The system shall support page version management, allowing the creation of multiple versions for a page and specifying which version is the current active version. Users shall be able to submit comments on pages, and comments shall support nested replies to other comments for discussion and communication. When creating page versions, users shall have the option to upload image information to enrich the page content. The system shall provide functionality to view page history records, facilitating the tracing and reverting to previous versions.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0125
CREATE TABLE `page` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `edit_status` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `visibility_status` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `active_version` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `comment` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `belonging_page` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `parent_comment` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `comment_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`belonging_page`) REFERENCES `page` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `comment_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_comment`) REFERENCES `comment` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `version_record` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `page_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `version_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `image_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `version_record_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`page_number`) REFERENCES `page` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
